privacy.title: Privacy & Data Governance
privacy.intro: As a Program Management & Localization consultancy, transparency and data integrity are core operational principles.
privacy.controller_desc: The data controller for this website is Mara Martins. For any enquiries regarding your data, please use the contact form or refer to the Imprint.
privacy.collection_desc: We only collect data you explicitly provide (Name, Email, Project Details) for the purpose of professional consultation. We do not use tracking cookies for marketing profiling.
privacy.infra_desc: Your data is persisted in a secure MongoDB Atlas cluster (AWS region) and processed via Render (Web Services). All data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
privacy.rights_desc: You have the right to access, rectify, or erase your data. Citizens of the EU may also lodge a complaint with their national supervisory authority.
privacy.supervisory_desc: In Portugal, the competent authority is the Comissão Nacional de Protecção de Dados (CNPD).

dashboard.title: AI Agents Governance HQ
dashboard.subtitle: Live Operations
dashboard.desc: This is a live operations centre where I manage a fleet of specialised AI agents that run quality audits, legal compliance checks, localisation reviews, and deployment verifications for this portfolio — in real time. Every agent finding surfaces here for my review and explicit approval before any change ships to production.
dashboard.heavy_lifting_desc: Autonomous agents run continuous audits — linguistic quality, legal compliance, visual integrity, and E2E testing — with zero manual triggering.
dashboard.human_control_desc: No agent decision reaches production without my explicit approval. Every finding below is reviewed, approved or blocked — by me.
dashboard.gates_desc: The merge gate below represents the current deployment health. Green means the full agent suite has signed off and the site is clear to ship.

merge.blocked_desc: Review and resolve all open findings before proceeding.
merge.cleared_desc: All findings reviewed. Safe to proceed with deployment.
